final_answer:
At C2D1, circulating immune-cell frequencies did not significantly correlate with serum protein levels after FDR correction. Across 16 CyTOF cell-population × Olink protein pairs, zero associations reached q < 0.05. The strongest nominal trends were modest and negative for CCR7+ CD11b+ CD27- B cells versus CXCL10 (rho = -0.214, p = 0.069) and CXCL9 (rho = -0.211, p = 0.073), but these did not survive multiple-testing correction.

Conclusion: no convincing on-treatment C2D1 cell-frequency/serum-protein correlation was detected in the provided subset of the PRINCE biomarker data.
